analysis.description: The paper introduces energy-based generative flow networks (EB-GFN), which is a novel probabilistic modeling algorithm for high-dimensional discrete data. It combines generative flow networks (GFlowNets) with energy-based models to improve probabilistic modeling accuracy and efficiency. The paper demonstrates the effectiveness of EB-GFN on various tasks and provides publicly available code for the algorithm.

name.quote: An energy landscape with well-separated modes is difficult to explore with local search methods. A GFlowNet, parametrized with a pair of stochastic policies P F (painting) and P B (erasure), exploits a broader state space S with partial choices, thus aiding the exploration of X that is necessary for updating the energy function with contrastive-divergence-like objectives. The trained GFlowNet is also a generative model on its own; see Figs. 2 and 6.
